test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Consider the production of three products, A, B and C, by three companies, X, Y and Z, in the given table.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09680d82e547ec692345eff8b2d3d6294dec44ed598f08353e3c548968edd645.png] 

Productions of how many products by company Y are more than the average production of all the products by company Y?
solution:
**Given:**

Production of products by company Y:

 
• Product A: 120
 
• Product B: 80
 
• Product C: 90

**Formula used:**

Average production by company Y = (Sum of productions of all products by company Y) / (Number of products)

**Calculation:**

Average production by company Y = (120 + 80 + 90) / 3

⇒ 290 / 3 = 96.66

Production of products by company Y:

 
• Product A: 120
 
• Product B: 80
 
• Product C: 90

Number of products with production more than average production:

 
• Product A: 120 (more than average)
 
• Product B: 80 (less than average)
 
• Product C: 90 (less than average)

⇒ Number of products with production more than average production = 1

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
